methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Kunin is a private frontier-tech company in Robotics & Manufacturing founded by Daniel Rau and Corey Donovan. Stage and current valuation remain undisclosed. The comparable universe consists of 10 same-sector peers: one public company (277810.KQ) and eight private firms including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics.

Peer-median valuation methodology was not applicable to this analysis. The dataset contained no peers matching Kunin's stage, adjacent stage, or valuation tier simultaneously—a minimum threshold of three datapoints is required for meaningful triangulation. While ten robotics and manufacturing companies exist in the broader peer set, applying sector-wide medians to a frontier-tech company would introduce substantial noise and obscure stage-specific and company-specific drivers of value.

Without sufficient narrow comparables and absent disclosed financial metrics, traditional DCF or revenue multiple approaches cannot be reliably applied. The analysis does not support a quantitative valuation range at this time. Key uncertainties limiting valuation precision include: stage classification clarity, revenue or funding-round details, and the ability to isolate stage-appropriate comparables within the robotics sector. Further data collection on Kunin's development milestones, customer traction, or recent funding activity would be necessary to enable robust triangulation against the identified peer universe.
